description.value: Between 2 Buns is a smash burger spot on East Pender Street in Vancouver, specializing in smashed patties with online ordering and a catering menu. The restaurant has no drive-through, making it a walk-in or order-ahead destination. It also sells branded merchandise, suggesting a loyal local following.
